layers.text: Change only the goblin's clothes: the red bandana becomes a brown leather cap and the red tunic becomes bare olive green shoulders with one brown leather strap. The leather is dull mid-brown, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows; no red and no orange left. Keep the goblin's face and ears, the grey wolf's head, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
